description: This file defines React components for an Accordion UI element, exporting Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, and AccordionContent components built on Radix UI's Accordion primitives.

methods.name: Accordion
methods.description: Main Accordion component wrapping Radix UI's Root component, forwards props.

methods.name: AccordionItem
methods.description: Represents an Accordion item, forwarding props and adding class names.

methods.name: AccordionTrigger
methods.description: Trigger element for the Accordion, displaying children and a ChevronDownIcon, with styling for open/closed states.

methods.name: AccordionContent
methods.description: Content area for Accordion, with animation and styling classes.
